# 2. Five-rule decision matrix
Five-rule decision matrix: apply the applicability gate first
Check / rule Satisfied only when Review required when
AZ-R1 Eligibility and need Follow Figure 1 on page 5; its labelled branches control AZ-R1. Use the review and not-applicable terminals in Figure 1. Do not infer eligibility.
AZ-R2 Daily rate Each day's BASE rate meets BOTH the contractual cap and the routine row in schedule A, or an applicable signed internal exception. Compare without mandatory tax. Any day exceeds a cap; exception not signed. Never divide a tax-inclusive total to invent a base rate. A policy limit or annual premium is not a billed daily rate.
AZ-R3 Duration and repair alignment Actual units meet BOTH remaining policy days and schedule A; full interval supported by actual repair downtime; prior loss-specific rental usage known (including explicit none). Scheduled repairs used as actual downtime; prior usage unknown; unsupported early pickup, late return or extension. Returned vehicle alone does not prove repair completion.
AZ-R4 Charges and reimbursement calculation Days x base + supported mandatory taxes/fees - credits = invoice total to $0.01; use schedule B to keep different bill types separate. Unexplained charge, unsupported mandatory status, duplicate line or arithmetic mismatch. Never add a total summary line to its itemized details twice.
AZ-R5 Authorization and payment readiness Final bill and completed return, plus insurer authorization covering dates and amount; any schedule A exception has required supervisor signature. No insurer authorization, pending/None/not-authorized status or unsigned exception. A customer's signature and a final bill do not authorize insurer payment.
Missing evidence is review, never an assumed pass. NOT APPLICABLE is a distinct outcome.

Gate / checkbox Required evidence Result / precedence

Rule Required handling Never do this

Authority band Daily base rate Days and approver

Observed item Treatment for rental review Exception / action
